settings.plot.help_getting_started.b01: In a world, press 0 by default to open Plot (change under Minecraft Settings -> Controls -> Plot); or right-click the Plot item in creative Tools.
settings.plot.help_getting_started.b02: Plot switches to orthographic view and hides the HUD; the game does not pause. Use the close button in the top-right to exit; Esc does not close Plot.
settings.plot.help_getting_started.b03: Draw in the central canvas area only (when the cursor is over toolbars or property panels, those panels capture input).
settings.plot.help_getting_started.b04: Draw a line: press L or click Line on the left toolbar; hold Shift for horizontal/vertical constraints.
settings.plot.help_getting_started.b05: Select: Space for box-select; left->right window (fully contained), right->left cross (intersects). Ctrl adds/removes. Select does not move shapes.
settings.plot.help_getting_started.b06: Move: switch to Move, click base and destination, or drag; hold Shift for horizontal/vertical.
settings.plot.help_getting_started.b07: Undo Ctrl+Z, redo Ctrl+Y (or Ctrl+Shift+Z), delete Delete, select all Ctrl+A.
settings.plot.help_getting_started.b08: View Range slider (40-600) zooms; middle-mouse drag pans; Canvas Opacity adjusts overlay transparency.
settings.plot.help_getting_started.b09: Block workflow: select shapes -> Block Config -> Line to Block (ghost preview) -> Project Blocks.
settings.plot.help_getting_started.b10: Clear Canvas on the top bar wipes all shapes (undoable); top-right toggles dark/light theme.
settings.plot.help_interface.b01: Top control panel: Settings & Help, undo/redo, snap/grid/clear, block config/line-to-block/projection, camera/lock, view range & opacity sliders.
settings.plot.help_interface.b02: Top-right system panel: dark/light theme and Close Plot button.
settings.plot.help_interface.b03: Left toolbar: Basic, Drawing, Special, Edit, Annotation groups; click icons to switch tools; options appear on the right.
settings.plot.help_interface.b04: Right tabs: Property (tool/layers/history/status), Gallery, Extensions; road node elevation appears in Property when a node is selected.
settings.plot.help_interface.b05: History: last 30 commands with timestamps; click an entry to jump to that state (auto undo/redo).
settings.plot.help_interface.b06: Layers: new/delete/merge/reorder, visibility, lock, color and line style; context menu; select all shapes on active layer.
settings.plot.help_interface.b07: All panels support dock layout; default layout is created on first open or when window size changes.
settings.plot.help_interface.b08: Snap/grid/line-to-block/projection/camera buttons support right-click for detailed settings dialogs.
settings.plot.help_interface.b09: Block Config opens the native Minecraft screen (leaves Plot sub-screen temporarily); up to 14 palette slots.
settings.plot.help_interface.b10: Esc order: cancel current tool -> clear selection -> clear ghost block previews.
settings.plot.help_tools.b01: Default keymap: Space select, D eraser, L line, P free draw, C circle, R rectangle, E ellipse, S semicircle, A arc.
settings.plot.help_tools.b02: No default keys: spline, polyline, polygon, star, spiral, catenary, sine, all edit/annotation tools - use the left toolbar.
settings.plot.help_tools.b03: Hold Shift while drawing for orthogonal/angle constraints; with snap on, Shift also temporarily disables snap.
settings.plot.help_tools.b04: Select tool: normal box and lasso modes (switch in tool properties); left->right window, right->left cross.
settings.plot.help_tools.b05: Edit tools: move, rotate, scale, mirror, align, array, offset, break, extend, trim, fillet, chamfer, transform.
settings.plot.help_tools.b06: Array tool: R/C/P switches rectangular/polar/path while active; Trim tool: C/F switches boundary/fence mode.
settings.plot.help_tools.b07: Fillet radius 1-100, eraser radius 1-20; scroll wheel adjusts spacing/parameters in multi-line, spiral, fillet, chamfer, etc.
settings.plot.help_tools.b08: Single selection enables control point editing (splines, polylines, pen curves); toggle control point display in Settings.
settings.plot.help_tools.b09: Annotation group: text plus dimension/angle/radius/area annotations; edit text content in tool properties.
settings.plot.help_tools.b10: Spline: press C to close; Rotate: hold Ctrl for copy-rotate; move/rotate and most edits support undo.
settings.plot.help_blocks.b01: Full workflow: select shapes -> Block Config -> Line to Block (ghost preview) -> Project Blocks.
settings.plot.help_blocks.b02: Palette holds up to 14 blocks; left-click add, right-click remove; Apply saves configuration.
settings.plot.help_blocks.b03: Line to Block is disabled without a selection; ghost blocks are semi-transparent; clear with Esc or close Plot.
settings.plot.help_blocks.b04: Right-click Line to Block: full/simplified conversion, closed fill, simplify ratio 0.1-1.0 (simplified mode only).
settings.plot.help_blocks.b05: Right-click Project: snap to ground (default) or fixed Y (-64 to 320); projection is undoable with Ctrl+Z.
settings.plot.help_blocks.b06: Line to Block height defaults to foot level; simplified conversion suits large structures with fewer blocks.
settings.plot.help_blocks.b07: Palette order affects multi-color line/region mapping; configure blocks before previewing.
settings.plot.help_blocks.b08: Plugins (road, earthwork, building) have separate preview/build flows - see Extension Plugins chapter.
settings.plot.help_settings.b01: Click Plot Settings & Help on the left of the control panel for shortcuts, snap feedback, and help.
settings.plot.help_settings.b02: Open Plot defaults to 0 (Minecraft Controls); Free Draw inside Plot defaults to P - separate bindings.
settings.plot.help_settings.b03: Shortcut table: search, double-click to record, per-action reset; saved to .minecraft/plot/keymap.json.
settings.plot.help_settings.b04: Global keys (not in shortcut table): Ctrl+A select all, Delete delete, Ctrl+Shift+Z redo.
settings.plot.help_settings.b05: Snap: left-click top button toggles; right-click for details; radius 1-50 px or 0.2-15 mm (Alt toggles unit).
settings.plot.help_settings.b06: Snap types: endpoint, midpoint, center, centroid, vertex, quadrant, grid, perpendicular, intersection, nearest, control, tangent; relations: horizontal, vertical, parallel, extension.
settings.plot.help_settings.b07: Grid: left-click toggles; right-click sets size 8-64, opacity, line width and color; enabled by default.
settings.plot.help_settings.b08: Feedback tab: toggle snap markers, marker size 2-10 px, per-type colors, control points and index display.
settings.plot.help_gallery.b01: Gallery tab on the right: built-in presets (building, landscape, shapes) and custom entries.
settings.plot.help_gallery.b02: Search filters by name/description; category tags filter entries; custom categories can be renamed/deleted via context menu.
settings.plot.help_gallery.b03: Select shapes on canvas, then Save selection to gallery with name, description and category.
settings.plot.help_gallery.b04: Click + on a row to enter placement mode, then click the canvas to place; Esc or Cancel exits placement.
settings.plot.help_gallery.b05: Drawing tools ignore clicks during placement; status bar shows the active gallery item name.
settings.plot.help_gallery.b06: Gallery stores shape data only, not block config; built-in presets are read-only; user entries can be deleted.
settings.plot.help_plugins.b01: Extension tab: click a plugin icon, check Enable plugin to show the panel; click icon again to deselect.
settings.plot.help_plugins.b02: Road System: adopt polylines/splines as centerlines, edit width/cross-section/materials, preview and project; config in config/plugins/road_system.json.
settings.plot.help_plugins.b03: Road panel tabs: Overview/Claim/Edit/Generate; node elevation editable in Property tab when a road node is selected.
settings.plot.help_plugins.b04: Earthwork Balance: claim closed regions; modes include flat, fixed slope, three-point, fit slope; red/blue ghost preview for cut/fill.
settings.plot.help_plugins.b05: Building Generator: pick footprints, configure floors/height/materials, generate 3D preview and project.
settings.plot.help_plugins.b06: All plugin panels use Overview/Claim/Edit/Generate tabs; pick modes capture canvas clicks; Esc cancels.
settings.plot.help_plugins.b07: Plugin project data saved under .minecraft/plot/plugins/ (JSON); no unified canvas layer save UI.
settings.plot.help_plugins.b08: Earthwork panel has its own undo/redo buttons for plugin-local operations.

hint.plot.road.tunnel_side_clearance: Controls the horizontal space between the carriageway edge and tunnel wall.
hint.plot.road.tunnel_lining_thickness: Controls the thickness of tunnel walls, roof, and structural floor.
hint.plot.road.tunnel_accent_spacing: Values above 0 place accent lining rings at this interval; 0 disables accent rings.
hint.plot.road.roadbed_grading: Road generation grades the subgrade to the design elevation: fill below the deck, cut above it, and carve tunnel cavities through deep overburden using the tunnel threshold.
hint.plot.road.fill_factor: Profile guide-line balance factor (not the earthwork fill factor). Values above 1.0 bias toward lower target grades to limit excess fill.
hint.plot.road.path_sample_distance: Centerline sample spacing in meters. Smaller = denser and slower previews.
hint.plot.road.default_crossing_clearanc: Default clearance (blocks) when a node is grade-separated and has no per-node clearance.
hint.plot.road.include_shoulder: Adds a narrow strip beside the road pavement for transition and edge protection.
hint.plot.road.shoulder_width: Width of the shoulder strip on each side of the road (in blocks).
hint.plot.road.fill_slope_ratio: Horizontal run per 1 block of vertical drop when filling embankment beside the shoulder. Accepts percent or 1:n ratio input.
hint.plot.road.cut_slope_ratio: Horizontal run per 1 block of vertical rise when cutting a slope beside the shoulder. Accepts percent or 1:n ratio input.
hint.plot.road.max_slope: Maximum longitudinal grade. Enter values like 8% or 1:12.5 directly.
hint.plot.road.road_name: Custom name for this logical road. Shown in lists and overview instead of the auto-generated label.
hint.plot.road.road_name_clear: Remove the custom name and revert to the auto-generated label.
hint.plot.road.reverse_road_direction: Reverse segment order and mirror all station-based data (PVI, sections, facilities).
hint.plot.road.chainage_display_mode: Re-label stations from the chain exit (E prefix). Does not reverse design direction.
hint.plot.road.relaxed_slope_percent: Grade limit for the relief segment inserted after a continuous climb reaches the slope-length cap.
hint.plot.road.default_corner_radius: Default curb corner radius for junctions without a per-node override.
hint.plot.road.junction_corner_radius: Sets all outer corner radii at once; edge trim and junction boolean paving run automatically.
hint.plot.road.include_drainage: Adds shallow drainage channels beside the road using gravel blocks.
hint.plot.road.road_width: Width of the paved carriageway only (blocks). Shoulders, sidewalks, bike lanes, and medians are configured separately.
hint.plot.road.streetlight_spacing: Spacing between streetlights along the road (blocks). 0 disables lights; enabled spacing is clamped to 8–50.
hint.plot.road.node_elevation: Manual node elevation in Minecraft world Y (-64 to 320). Leave auto to follow terrain sampling.
hint.plot.road.overview_view_profile: Open Generate tab and show the longitudinal profile for this segment (requires preview data).
hint.plot.road.delete_entire_road: Remove the logical road and all of its geometry segments.
hint.plot.road.delete_segment: Remove only this geometry segment. The logical road keeps other segments.
hint.plot.road.split_road: Split the logical road before this segment into two roads without deleting geometry.
hint.plot.road.split_road_first_segment: Cannot split before the first segment. Select a later segment to start a new road group.
hint.plot.earthwork.fill_factor: Compaction factor for fill material. Values above 1.0 mean loose fill settles when compacted, so more cut volume is needed to reach the target grade.
hint.plot.earthwork.reusable_ratio: Share of geometric cut spoil that can be reused on site (bank measure). The remainder is treated as export.
hint.plot.earthwork.site_material_model: Site-wide default material conversion. Newly adopted regions inherit this model; override per region in the Edit tab.
hint.plot.earthwork.cut_material_class: Material class of spoil produced by cut in this zone. Rock/unsuitable spoil is never allocated to fill — it is exported.
hint.plot.earthwork.fill_material_class: Material class this zone's fill will accept. The allocation matrix only moves compatible spoil here.
hint.plot.earthwork.cut_to_compacted_fil: Compacted fill volume formed per 1 m³ of reusable cut spoil. Balance target: geometric cut × reusable ratio × this ratio ≈ geometric fill.
hint.plot.earthwork.grid_size: Sampling grid spacing in meters. Affects volume statistics and preview grid density only; block placement still covers the full region boundary.
hint.plot.earthwork.preview_grid_size: Density of the top-down cut/fill preview in the panel only. Does not affect balance solving or volume accuracy.
hint.plot.earthwork.surface_mode: Choose the target grading surface: flat, fixed slope, three-point plane, or auto-fitted slope.
hint.plot.earthwork.auto_balance: Automatically find the elevation where cut and fill volumes (including fill factor) are closest within the region.
hint.plot.earthwork.balance_method: Statistics scope is separate from grade changes. "None" only reports; uniform shift / constrained optimization may adjust eligible zones.
hint.plot.earthwork.optimization_mode: Orthogonal to statistics scope: SITE+None = inspect net earthwork only; SITE+constrained optimization = adjust eligible zones to cut import/export. Allocation matrix never changes grades.
hint.plot.earthwork.vertical_adjustment_: Separates design elevation (locked/derived) from earthwork optimization. Only bounded/adjustable zones take site-wide ΔY; weight scales the uniform residual, not zone-allocation magnitudes.
Uniform site ΔY is multiplied by this weight, then clamped. 1.0 matches the solver; landscape zones usually use a lower weight to soak residual.

hint.plot.earthwork.slope_pitch: Slope ratio: horizontal run per 1 block of rise (higher values mean gentler slopes).
hint.plot.earthwork.slope_anchor_elevati: Target world height (Y) at the slope anchor point.
